recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.summary: The fastest way to turn leftover rice and a little chicken into a full dinner.
steps: Heat a large pan or wok over high heat with a little oil.
Fry the chicken until golden and cooked through, then set it aside.
Add the garlic and peas and cook for a minute.
Push everything to one side, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble them.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes so it picks up some colour.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and toss to coat.
Finish with spring onions and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Pasta Arrabbiata
recipes.summary: Store-cupboard pasta with a bit of heat. Ready in the time the water boils.
steps: Put a pan of well-salted water on to boil and cook the pasta.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan and soften the garlic without colouring it.
Add the chilli flakes, then the tomatoes, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening it with the pasta water.
Serve with parmesan if you have it.

recipes.title: Spinach & Cheddar Omelette
recipes.summary: Three ingredients, five minutes, and a good use for spinach that is on the turn.
steps: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Wilt the spinach for a minute, then season it.
Pour in the eggs and draw the set edges into the middle.
When it is almost set, scatter over the cheddar.
Fold and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Strawberry Yoghurt Bowl
recipes.summary: A two-minute breakfast that rescues strawberries on their last day.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with the strawberries.
Add a little honey if you want it sweeter.

recipes.title: Tomato & Garlic Bruschetta
recipes.summary: Bread that is a day past its best becomes the point of the dish.
steps: Toast the bread until it is crisp at the edges.
Rub each slice with the cut side of the garlic.
Season the tomatoes with salt and a little olive oil.
Pile the tomatoes onto the toast and finish with basil.

recipes.title: Chicken & Spinach Traybake
recipes.summary: Everything on one tray, in the oven, hands off for half an hour.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Toss the chicken, tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil and season well.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Stir the spinach through the hot tray until it wilts.
Rest for a couple of minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
recipes.summary: Pasta, cheese, pepper. Nothing else, and nothing missing.
steps: Cook the pasta in less water than usual so the water stays starchy.
Toast the pepper in a dry pan for thirty seconds.
Add a ladle of pasta water and the butter, and swirl to combine.
Off the heat, add the pasta and cheese and toss hard until glossy.
Loosen with more pasta water if it tightens.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Rice, eggs, peas. The dish to make when the fridge looks empty.
steps: Get the pan very hot with a little oil.
Scramble the eggs quickly and lift them out.
Fry the garlic and peas for a minute.
Add the rice and press it into the pan so it crisps a little.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce and toss together.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup with Cheese Toast
recipes.summary: Tinned tomatoes made worth eating, with the last of the bread alongside.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for eight minutes.
Add the tomatoes and a tin of water, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, or leave it rustic.
Grill the bread with the cheddar on top until bubbling.
Season the soup and serve with the toast.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta with Peas
recipes.summary: Freezer peas, a knob of butter, and dinner is on the table in twelve minutes.
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last two minutes.
Melt the butter with the garlic over a low heat until fragrant.
Drain the pasta and peas, keeping some water.
Toss everything together with a splash of the water.
Finish with parmesan and plenty of pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Wraps
recipes.summary: Cooked chicken, yoghurt and whatever salad is in the drawer.
steps: Season the chicken and fry it until cooked through.
Stir the crushed garlic into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt.
Warm the wraps briefly in the dry pan.
Fill with chicken, spinach and tomato, then spoon over the yoghurt.
Roll tightly and cut in half.

recipes.title: Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: One pan, eggs poached straight in the sauce. Good at any hour.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and chilli and simmer until thick, about ten minutes.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook gently until the whites are set but the yolks are soft.
Serve from the pan with bread.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pancakes
recipes.summary: A weekend breakfast built out of eggs, milk and fruit that needs using.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk and eggs into a smooth batter and rest it for ten minutes.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook spoonfuls of batter until bubbles appear, then flip.
Keep the pancakes warm while you cook the rest.
Serve stacked with the strawberries on top.

recipes.title: Strawberry Smoothie
recipes.summary: Yoghurt, milk and soft fruit, blended before it goes to waste.
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend until smooth, adding more milk if it is too thick.
Pour and drink cold.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach Rice
recipes.summary: A quiet, filling supper from three things you almost certainly have.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter.
Add the rice and stir to coat, then add water and cook until tender.
Fold the spinach through so it wilts in the residual heat.
Stir in the cheddar until it melts.
Season generously and serve.

recipes.title: Simple Tomato Pasta Bake
recipes.summary: Assembled in ten minutes, then the oven does the rest.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and boil the pasta until just short of done.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes and simmer.
Combine the pasta and sauce and tip into a baking dish.
Scatter the cheese over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until browned and bubbling.

recipes.title: Yoghurt Marinated Chicken
recipes.summary: Yoghurt keeps the chicken soft. Worth starting in the morning if you can.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, garlic, chilli and lemon with plenty of salt.
Coat the chicken and leave it for at least 30 minutes, or all day in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220°C or get the grill very hot.
Cook for 18–20 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Rest briefly and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Peas & Parmesan on Toast
recipes.summary: Frozen peas crushed with cheese and oil — better than it has any right to be.
steps: Boil the peas for three minutes and drain them.
Crush them roughly with the oil, cheese and a squeeze of lemon.
Season well — peas take more salt than you expect.
Pile onto the toast.
